sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on Major highways and arterials in Everett or surface streets in Everett can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.

sections.heading: Washington reporting rules
paragraphs: Washington requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 25/50/10.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://wsdot.wa.gov/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
Washington uses Pure comparative comparative negligence; anything you say can affect fault allocation.
